label: Basic
description: Basic hover card. Best for the minimal anatomy: an outline button whose long press opens a card with a heading over one muted line.

label: Positions
description: Hover cards on different sides. Best for a grid of triggers, one per side, each opening its card on the side its label names.

label: Profile
description: Hover card with a profile. Best for a person's avatar and handle as the trigger, a long press opening a larger avatar with role and join date.

label: Icon
description: Hover card with an icon. Best for a feature callout on an outline button, an amber bolt beside a short title and a muted blurb.

label: Image & Text
description: Hover card with an image. Best for an edge to edge 16:9 picture across the top of a wide card, captioned by a title and one line.

label: In Dialog
description: Hover card inside a dialog. Best for a trigger in the body of an open dialog, below its title and description, for previews inside a dialog.

label: Live Timestamp
description: Timestamp hover card. Best for a dashed underline relative time inside a sentence, a long press opening the exact time in 3 zones.

label: Release Notes
description: Hover card with release notes. Best for a dashed What's new link opening release entries stepped through with arrow buttons and a dot per entry.
